capture.method: Supabase dashboard Edge Functions Code view; Monaco model read in the page (window.monaco.editor.getModels()[0].getValue()). No file download, no CLI call, no request against the deployed endpoints.
operations_performed: GET /dashboard/project/<ref>/functions/pairing/code and /auth-bootstrap/code, plus in-page selection of each _shared/*.ts entry in the file tree
in-page JS reads of the Monaco model text (no pointer input required)
local SHA-256 computed in the page via crypto.subtle over the exact model text
operations_not_performed: no cookie, localStorage, session token or credential read
no ZIP export, no supabase CLI login/link/download
no function deployment, edit, test invocation or log query
no SQL, no DDL/DML, no GRANT/REVOKE, no config change
capture.sanitisation: Only function source and counts are recorded. No secret value, JWT, URL with key, connection string or row data appears in this file.
capture.source_form_note: Two functions are served as readable TypeScript. Seven are served as 2-line esbuild bundles with all imported modules inlined and identifiers minified. Line numbers are therefore only meaningful for the readable pair and for the shared modules as served under pairing/.
capture.char_count_note: len is JavaScript string length (UTF-16 code units) of the editor text, not bytes on disk.

functions.auth_model: user JWT (all actions); parent or child role per action; family membership asserted per action

redeem: 562-564: comment - token row keeps plain SHA-256 for legacy compatibility
unlink: 929-939: actor is child (self) or parent in the body family

functions.auth_model: user JWT + verified email; set_role is self-only and one-time from 'unset'; create_family is parent-only
create: parent JWT + verified email + requireActiveDeviceForParent; poll/ack: device header credentials (x-device-id + x-device-secret)

create: apply_policy -> rpc apply_policy_version {p_device_id, p_policy, p_actor:o.user.id, p_idempotency_key}
device_commands select by device_id + idempotency_key before insert
ack: apply_policy ack updates device_policies and devices.policy_version scoped to device

functions.auth_model: child JWT + verified email + assertChildMembership(body family_id)

register: single action guard: if(n!=="register") throw unknown_action
existing installation in family -> child mismatch = 409 device_exists
revoked device + later approved pairing -> device_registration_blocked
insert/update devices with secret_hash from client
audit device_registered / device_recredentialed / device_registration_blocked with actorUserId = JWT user

update: strict key allowlists V/X/Z; arrays capped 200; app_rules 100

functions.auth_model: device only (x-device-id + x-device-secret); device_id and family_id always taken from the authenticated device row

heartbeat: low_battery alert deduped in a 6-hour window
usage_upload: entries max 500; day must be a real date and not beyond now+36h
rows carry device_id/family_id from the device row
location_upload: safe_zones evaluation -> safe_zone_states upsert + safety_alerts insert

functions.auth_model: parent JWT + verified email for every action; update_retention additionally owner-only

ack_alert: safety_alerts select by alert_id, family asserted before update
purge_data: family asserted; retention defaults 30/90 days, floor = max(requested, configured)

functions.auth_model: user JWT + verified email; parent for request, child for pending_child/respond/start, either participant for end/ice

request: direct insert into remote_sessions (not the public.request_remote_session RPC)
parent_user_id = JWT user, child_user_id = device.child_user_id, expires_at = now + 10 min, consent_recorded false
pending_child: expire stale requested rows for the child, then list up to 50
respond: accept sets consent_recorded true, session_nonce randomUUID, expires_at now + 30 min
start: child-only; requires status accepted and consent_recorded; .eq(status,"accepted") guard
end: either participant; terminal states returned as-is; update .in(status,[requested,accepted,active])
ice: participant; status accepted|active; consent_recorded required; TURN credential HMAC-SHA1 with TURN_SECRET, username '<expiry>:<user id>', TTL clamp 60..86400 default 600

functions.auth_model: shared secret in x-cron-secret; CRON_SECRET must be at least 16 chars or the function returns 503

auth: compare = SHA-256 of both sides then constant-time equal, case-insensitive hex

shared.note: recordAudit inserts audit_logs with a caller-supplied actor_user_id and throws audit_failed (500) on insert error.
getServiceClient (service role), bearerToken, requireUser (db.auth.getUser), requireRole, assertFamilyMember/Parent/Child/Owner, requireActiveDeviceForParent, requireDevice (sha256 + constant-time).
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and an allow-headers list that includes authorization, x-device-secret and x-cron-secret.
ApiError, ok/fail, errorResponse (logs error.name only, generic 500), readJson (512 KB cap, object-only), requireAction, ensureNoError (logs error.code only).
Pairing-only limits: 5 failed attempts per parent / 10 per identifier in 10 min, 5 live codes per 24 h, 10 creations per hour, 3 pending invites, 10 invites per 24 h. All counts are read-then-act.
Regexes, typed readers, CSPRNG pairing code / Child ID, sha256Hex, identifierHash (HMAC with PAIRING_HASH_PEPPER, silent fallback to SHA-256), constant-time helpers.

repository.note: supabase/config.toml declares local API schemas [public, graphql_public]. The deployed project exposes [public, extensions] and offers private, so the local file is not a description of production.
